target_customer: Data teams and analysts who write SQL and want BI as code, from startups to large enterprises
problem: Drag and drop BI tools produce dashboards that are hard to version, review and customize. Evidence builds reports from SQL and markdown in a Git repository.
business_model: Open source core with a paid hosted product (Evidence Cloud, launched 2023) and enterprise offerings

founders.name: Adam McAskill
prior_employers: A leading Canadian private equity fund (not named)
founders.background_notes: YC page: led the data science team at the fund. Launch HN post by user amcaskill.

founders.name: Sean Hughes
prior_employers: A leading Canadian private equity fund (not named)
founders.background_notes: Listed identically to McAskill on the YC page; author of the 2023 seed blog post.

competitors.name: Metabase
competitors.what: Open source drag and drop BI tool

competitors.name: Looker
competitors.what: Commercial BI platform, part of Google

competitors.name: Streamlit
competitors.what: Python framework for interactive data apps; founders said it targets standalone apps rather than reporting

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on SvelteKit and a markdown preprocessor with SQL query integration across many warehouses; solid engineering, not research.

defensibility.rationale: Open source MIT core can be forked; value comes from community and the hosted product.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents did not copy it in sources opened; code first BI approaches emerged from several vendors, not tracked here.

market_need_then: Launch HN commenters in August 2021 voiced frustration with Looker, Metabase and Power BI, and the modern data stack (dbt, Fivetran, BigQuery) was growing, creating demand for code based reporting.

branding.domain_note: Uses evidence.dev, a developer TLD rather than .com

identity.logo: Black wordmark; a media kit is offered on GitHub (company site)
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and developer focused; 'Business intelligence as code'

branding.brand_signature: BI as code positioning and open source community on GitHub and Slack
branding.community_and_virality: Open source repo with about 5,100 stars by an older snapshot and 6.5k by 2026 per aggregators; Slack community; Evidence 2.0 launched on Product Hunt.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong niche developer awareness through open source, but the word 'evidence' is generic and hard to search.

outcome_analysis: Evidence grew through an open source project and a Launch HN in August 2021, then raised a $2.1M seed in September 2023 led by A.Capital when it launched a hosted Evidence Cloud. It reports large enterprise users, but no later round was found and the funding is small, so scale remains modest.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company blog and TechCrunch (headline and search snippet). Aggregators give a $4M total or $2.21M across two rounds; an earlier pre-seed is unclear and not recorded. Competitors come from commenters and founders on the Launch HN thread dated August 25, 2021. The seed blog and company site name no competitors. Founders listed on the YC page; the HN post gives first names only.
